include { RPBP_PREPAREGENOME                } from 'nf-core/rpbp/preparegenome'
include { RPBP_EXTRACTMETAGENEPROFILES      } from 'nf-core/rpbp/extractmetageneprofiles'
include { RPBP_ESTIMATEMETAGENEBAYESFACTORS } from 'nf-core/rpbp/estimatemetagenebayesfactors'
include { RPBP_SELECTPERIODICOFFSETS        } from 'nf-core/rpbp/selectperiodicoffsets'
include { RPBP_GETPERIODICLENGTHSOFFSETS    } from 'nf-core/rpbp/getperiodiclengthsoffsets'
include { RPBP_EXTRACTORFPROFILES           } from 'nf-core/rpbp/extractorfprofiles'
include { RPBP_ESTIMATEORFBAYESFACTORS      } from 'nf-core/rpbp/estimateorfbayesfactors'
include { RPBP_SELECTFINALPREDICTIONSET     } from 'nf-core/rpbp/selectfinalpredictionset'

workflow FASTA_GTF_BAM_RPBP {

    take:
    ch_bam        // channel: [ val(meta), path(bam), path(bai) ] - Ribo-seq BAMs
    ch_fasta_gtf  // channel (single value): [ val(meta), path(fasta), path(gtf) ]

    main:

    RPBP_PREPAREGENOME(ch_fasta_gtf)

    ch_transcript_bed   = RPBP_PREPAREGENOME.out.transcript_bed.first()
    ch_orfs_genomic_bed = RPBP_PREPAREGENOME.out.orfs_genomic_bed.first()
    ch_orfs_exons_bed   = RPBP_PREPAREGENOME.out.orfs_exons_bed.first()
    ch_genome_fasta     = ch_fasta_gtf.map { meta, fasta, _gtf -> [ meta, fasta ] }.first()

    RPBP_EXTRACTMETAGENEPROFILES (
        ch_bam,
        ch_transcript_bed
    )

    RPBP_ESTIMATEMETAGENEBAYESFACTORS (
        RPBP_EXTRACTMETAGENEPROFILES.out.metagene
    )

    RPBP_SELECTPERIODICOFFSETS (
        RPBP_ESTIMATEMETAGENEBAYESFACTORS.out.bayes_factors
    )

    RPBP_GETPERIODICLENGTHSOFFSETS (
        RPBP_SELECTPERIODICOFFSETS.out.periodic
    )

    ch_extract_in = ch_bam
        .join(RPBP_GETPERIODICLENGTHSOFFSETS.out.lengths_offsets, by: 0)

    RPBP_EXTRACTORFPROFILES (
        ch_extract_in,
        ch_orfs_genomic_bed,
        ch_orfs_exons_bed
    )

    RPBP_ESTIMATEORFBAYESFACTORS (
        RPBP_EXTRACTORFPROFILES.out.profiles,
        ch_orfs_genomic_bed
    )

    RPBP_SELECTFINALPREDICTIONSET (
        RPBP_ESTIMATEORFBAYESFACTORS.out.bayes_factors,
        ch_genome_fasta
    )

    emit:
    transcript_bed   = RPBP_PREPAREGENOME.out.transcript_bed               // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.annotated.bed.gz) ]
    orfs_genomic_bed = RPBP_PREPAREGENOME.out.orfs_genomic_bed             // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.orfs-genomic.annotated.bed.gz) ]
    orfs_exons_bed   = RPBP_PREPAREGENOME.out.orfs_exons_bed               // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.orfs-exons.annotated.bed.gz) ]
    metagene         = RPBP_EXTRACTMETAGENEPROFILES.out.metagene           // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.metagene.csv.gz) ]
    metagene_bf      = RPBP_ESTIMATEMETAGENEBAYESFACTORS.out.bayes_factors // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.metagene-bayes.csv.gz) ]
    periodic         = RPBP_SELECTPERIODICOFFSETS.out.periodic             // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.offsets.csv.gz) ]
    lengths_offsets  = RPBP_GETPERIODICLENGTHSOFFSETS.out.lengths_offsets  // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.lengths-offsets.tsv) ]
    orf_profiles     = RPBP_EXTRACTORFPROFILES.out.profiles                // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.profiles.mtx.gz) ]
    orf_bayes        = RPBP_ESTIMATEORFBAYESFACTORS.out.bayes_factors      // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.bayes-factors.bed.gz) ]
    predicted        = RPBP_SELECTFINALPREDICTIONSET.out.predicted         // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.predicted-orfs.bed.gz) ]
    dna_fasta        = RPBP_SELECTFINALPREDICTIONSET.out.dna_fasta         // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.predicted-orfs.dna.fa) ]
    protein_fasta    = RPBP_SELECTFINALPREDICTIONSET.out.protein_fasta     // channel: [ val(meta), path(*.predicted-orfs.protein.fa) ]
}

---
name: "nf-core/fasta_gtf_bam_rpbp"
description: "End-to-end translated-ORF discovery from ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq)\
  \ data\nwith Rp-Bp (Malone et al. 2017). Ribo-seq sequences the short mRNA\nfootprints\
  \ protected by translating ribosomes; Rp-Bp uses a Bayesian model\nto score which\
  \ open reading frames (ORFs) on the transcriptome show the\ncharacteristic 3-nucleotide\
  \ periodicity of active translation.\n\nGiven a genome FASTA, annotation GTF and\
  \ one or more pre-aligned Ribo-seq\nBAMs, the subworkflow:\n  1. Builds the per-ORF\
  \ reference (rpbp/preparegenome) once per run -\n     enumerates candidate ORFs\
  \ from the GTF.\n  2. For each sample, builds per-read-length metagene profiles\
  \ around\n     annotated start codons (extract-metagene-profiles), scores their\n\
  \     three-nucleotide periodicity with Bayesian models\n     (estimate-metagene-profile-bayes-factors),\
  \ picks the best P-site\n     offset per periodic read length (select-periodic-offsets),\
  \ and\n     filters down to the high-confidence read-length/offset pairs that\n\
  \     will drive ORF-level scoring (get-periodic-lengths-offsets).\n  3. Builds\
  \ per-ORF P-site count vectors with those selected offsets\n     (extract-orf-profiles),\
  \ scores each ORF as \"translated\" vs\n     \"untranslated\" with a Bayesian model\
  \ (estimate-orf-bayes-factors),\n     and emits the final filtered set of predicted\
  \ translated ORFs as\n     BED + DNA FASTA + protein FASTA (select-final-prediction-set).\n\
  \nEach Rp-Bp step is a separate Nextflow process so `-resume` only re-runs\nwhat\
  \ changed, and STAR/bowtie alignment is supplied via the BAM input\n(this subworkflow\
  \ does not realign).\n"
keywords:
- "rpbp"
- "orf"
- "bayesian"
- "translation"
- "riboseq"
components:
- "rpbp/preparegenome"
- "rpbp/extractmetageneprofiles"
- "rpbp/estimatemetagenebayesfactors"
- "rpbp/selectperiodicoffsets"
- "rpbp/getperiodiclengthsoffsets"
- "rpbp/extractorfprofiles"
- "rpbp/estimateorfbayesfactors"
- "rpbp/selectfinalpredictionset"
input:
- ch_bam:
    description: "Per-sample Ribo-seq BAM with index. Filter to Ribo-seq libraries\n\
      upstream.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam), path(bai) ]\n"
- ch_fasta_gtf:
    description: "Single-value channel of genome FASTA + annotation GTF. The GTF may\n\
      be canonical or a hybrid (e.g. extended-ORF mode).\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta), path(gtf) ]\n"
output:
- transcript_bed:
    description: "Annotated transcripts BED produced by `rpbp/preparegenome`.\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(*.annotated.bed.gz) ]\n"
- orfs_genomic_bed:
    description: "Per-ORF genomic BED produced by `rpbp/preparegenome`.\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(*.orfs-genomic.annotated.bed.gz) ]\n"
- orfs_exons_bed:
    description: "Per-ORF exons BED produced by `rpbp/preparegenome`.\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(*.orfs-exons.annotated.bed.gz) ]\n"
- metagene:
    description: "Per-sample metagene profiles.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(*.metagene.csv.gz)\
      \ ]\n"
- metagene_bf:
    description: "Per-sample metagene periodicity Bayes factors.\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(*.metagene-bayes.csv.gz) ]\n"
- periodic:
    description: "Per-sample selected periodic offsets.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(*.offsets.csv.gz)\
      \ ]\n"
- lengths_offsets:
    description: "Per-sample selected lengths/offsets actually used by extract-orf-profiles.\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(*.lengths-offsets.tsv) ]\n"
- orf_profiles:
    description: "Per-sample per-ORF P-site profile matrix.\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(*.profiles.mtx.gz) ]\n"
- orf_bayes:
    description: "Per-sample per-ORF translation Bayes factors.\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(*.bayes-factors.bed.gz) ]\n"
- predicted:
    description: "Per-sample final filtered predicted-ORF BED.\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(*.predicted-orfs.bed.gz) ]\n"
- dna_fasta:
    description: "Per-sample predicted-ORF DNA FASTA.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(*.predicted-orfs.dna.fa)\
      \ ]\n"
- protein_fasta:
    description: "Per-sample predicted-ORF protein FASTA.\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(*.predicted-orfs.protein.fa) ]\n"
authors:
- "@pinin4fjords"
maintainers:
- "@pinin4fjords"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/rpbp/preparegenome@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rpbp/extractmetageneprofiles@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rpbp/estimatemetagenebayesfactors@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rpbp/selectperiodicoffsets@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rpbp/getperiodiclengthsoffsets@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rpbp/extractorfprofiles@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rpbp/estimateorfbayesfactors@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rpbp/selectfinalpredictionset@0.0.0-6d1763b"
